tools.name: cheapest_gpu
tools.description: Cheapest on-demand price for a GPU model at EU cloud providers (EUR per GPU-hour, ex-VAT, checked daily). Optional filters: EU-owned providers only, data-centre country, how many GPUs you need (drops offers sold only in bigger bundles), no US parent, EU data centre.

tools.name: compare_providers
tools.description: Every EU provider that lists a GPU model on demand, cheapest first, with country, minimum GPU count, sovereignty tags and source link.

tools.name: price_history
tools.description: Daily EU price history for a GPU model (cheapest, median, number of offers and price per provider for each day we have a check).

tools.name: list_providers
tools.description: EU GPU cloud providers tracked by gpueuro with sovereignty facts: EU ownership, US parent, EU data centres, certifications, GPU models and whether they are quote-only.

tools.name: request_quote_link
tools.description: Returns a pre-filled link to the gpueuro quote form for multi-GPU or reserved capacity from EU clouds that do not publish prices (e.g. STACKIT, Sesterce, evroc, Nscale). Only returns a URL for the user to open; nothing is submitted.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: request_quote_link · Public sink: request_quote_link.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: request_quote_link · Public sink: request_quote_link

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
